sources.note: Standing; kneeling or sitting; prone. Two sighters before each of the four parts; the scored parts are 2 x 5 or 4 x 5 shots.

provenance.note: The calibre must be one introduced for the rifle in a regular army, the police or customs and may not exceed 8 mm. The discipline is shot at 100 or 300 m at the choice stated in D.9.9.
